topology.indexing: Exact source coordinates within each building instance/material; disjoint indices across instances. Terrain retains source vertex indexing.
topology.numerical_precision_warning: Topology and areas are computed from source float64 coordinates. Mitsuba/Sionna typically loads float32 vertices; near-collinear slivers may change normal direction or collapse there. No automatic removal, upward flip, coordinate rounding or outward-normal repair is applied.
topology.scope: Exported triangles after world-z0 omission. Physical building adjacency is checked within each instance before material splitting. No inter-building, building/terrain intersection, T-junction, self-intersection or outward-normal proof.
topology.native_material_limitation: Sionna 2.2 uses one RadioMaterialBase BSDF per mesh; built-in RadioMaterial uses the same material for both wedge faces. Cross-shape wedges are unsupported; no material averaging or custom heterogeneous diffraction is applied.

assumptions: Geometry is a synthetic planning layout, not a surveyed city.
Region labels are planning roles, not measured population; UE candidates are a sounding grid, not active subscribers.
Source face winding preserved; no repair, tolerance welding, outward-normal proof or watertightness claim. Indexed adjacency diagnostics are not a full geometry validity proof.
Loader must use face_normals=True, flip_normals=False and remove_duplicate_vertices=False; native SceneObject(fname=...) otherwise flips normals by default in installed Sionna 2.2.
Material partitioning preserves exact tags but cannot represent native cross-material wedges. Consult strict diffraction and free-edge diffraction gates separately.
Only building faces exactly coplanar with world z=0 are omitted to avoid duplicate ground surfaces; elevated local-z0 faces retained.
Vegetation propagation is disabled and RT-enabled vegetation rejected; all vegetation footprints exclude UE candidates.
Source material records are retained. Scattering translation is an explicit model assumption, not a validated source-equivalence claim.

parcel_catalog.boundary_policy: Polygon covers includes boundary; multiple matches use lowest source parcel index.
parcel_catalog.outside_policy: Keep every UE outside actual parcel polygons in outside-parcels; no nearest assignment.
parcel_catalog.split_policy: No train/val/test partition. All UEs of a parcel stay together, including unusable links.

note: CPU-only re-export; all source RT paths and per-sector CFR remain at source_run, not copied or modified.
